📖 What to Look For (Based on Published Symptom Literature)

HEALTHY — Yellow Maize
  • Mask should be near-empty (black / <1% fill)
  • Uniform rich green or deep yellow leaf colour with bright midrib
  • No pale streaks, no chlorotic patches, no margin browning
  • 3-band guard: <1% → zero | 1–4% → ×0.3 | ≥4% → genuine early signal
  • ⚠️ If mask >4%: raise HEALTHY_A_MIN (140→145) or HEALTHY_B_MIN (145→150)
MSV — Maize Streak Virus
  • Mask should show narrow, broken, vein-parallel streaks
  • Streak colours: pale green → yellow → white (not solid blotches)
  • On yellow maize: paler/whiter interruptions of the yellow background
  • Gabor (4 orientations) reinforces streak structure — should NOT mask whole leaf
  • Early: scattered round spots (~0.5–2mm) that elongate into streaks (Philippines 2024)
  • ⚠️ Mask empty: lower LAB_MSV_B_MIN or GABOR_THRESHOLD | Mask full: raise LAB_MSV_A_MIN
MLN — Maize Lethal Necrosis
  • Mask should show broad yellowing + margin-to-midrib necrosis
  • Unlike MSV: streaks are wider, less vein-bound
  • Leaves dry from outer margins inward toward midrib
  • Dark necrotic patches (brown/black) captured by dark_necrosis branch (L*<110, a*≥125)
  • Advanced: whole leaf dries; mottled mosaic pattern visible
  • ⚠️ Only margins masked: lower dark_necrosis L*<110→120 | Mask full: raise LAB_MLN_A_MIN
